snippet.title: Scratchin' Melodii - My Darling Is A Robot (Gameplay Preview)
snippet.description:
This is a preview of the boss battle against Dr. Nitrofunk in my upcoming game, Scratchin' Melodii! Feat. Jay M as Dr. Nitrofunk! 👨🏾‍🔬

Wishlist Scratchin' Melodii on Steam here!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2728050/Scratchin_Melodii/

Credits:
Music, Art, Animation, Etc - LJ LephemStar
Vocal Tuning/Mixing, Robo-Darling Boxart Drawing - Mia (2cada)
Voice of Dr. Nitrofunk - Jay M
